check_in_challenges_consumed_at_ck.name: check_in_challenges_consumed_at_ck
check_in_challenges_consumed_at_ck.value:
("check_in_challenges"."status" = 'consumed' AND "check_in_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("check_in_challenges"."status" <> 'consumed' AND "check_in_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NULL)

creator_profiles_verified_locality_ck.name: creator_profiles_verified_locality_ck
creator_profiles_verified_locality_ck.value:
"creator_profiles"."locality_status" <> 'verified' OR (
        "creator_profiles"."verified_postal_area" IS NOT NULL AND
        "creator_profiles"."locality_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "creator_profiles"."locality_expires_at" > "creator_profiles"."locality_verified_at"
      )

deliverable_requirements_duration_ck.name: deliverable_requirements_duration_ck
deliverable_requirements_duration_ck.value:
("deliverable_requirements"."min_duration_seconds" IS NULL AND "deliverable_requirements"."max_duration_seconds" IS NULL) OR
          ("deliverable_requirements"."min_duration_seconds" > 0 AND "deliverable_requirements"."max_duration_seconds" >= "deliverable_requirements"."min_duration_seconds")

financial_action_intents_posted_shape_ck.name: financial_action_intents_posted_shape_ck
financial_action_intents_posted_shape_ck.value:
("financial_action_intents"."status" = 'pending_ledger' AND "financial_action_intents"."posted_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("financial_action_intents"."status" = 'posted' AND "financial_action_intents"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_accounts_platform_code_currency_u.name: ledger_accounts_platform_code_currency_uq
ledger_accounts_platform_code_currency_u.where: "ledger_accounts"."campaign_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."creator_user_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."business_id" IS NULL

ledger_accounts_scope_ck.name: ledger_accounts_scope_ck

ledger_transactions_shape_ck.name: ledger_transactions_shape_ck
ledger_transactions_shape_ck.value:
(
        "ledger_transactions"."type" = 'campaign_funding' AND "ledger_transactions"."source_type" = 'provider_funding'
        AND "ledger_transactions"."payment_provider_reference_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_transactions"."campaign_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_transactions"."mission_assignment_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_transactions"."created_by_user_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "ledger_transactions"."type" IN ('slot_completion', 'slot_refund')
        AND "ledger_transactions"."source_type" = 'financial_action_intent'
        AND "ledger_transactions"."payment_provider_reference_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_transactions"."campaign_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_transactions"."mission_assignment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_transactions"."created_by_user_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "ledger_transactions"."type" = 'finance_adjustment' AND "ledger_transactions"."source_type" = 'finance_adjustment'
        AND "ledger_transactions"."payment_provider_reference_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_transactions"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(btrim("ledger_transactions"."reason")) > 0
      )

media_assets_validation_state_ck.name: media_assets_validation_state_ck
media_assets_validation_state_ck.value:
("media_assets"."status" = 'pending_scan' AND "media_assets"."validation_reason" IS NULL AND "media_assets"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("media_assets"."status" = 'verified' AND "media_assets"."validation_reason" IS NULL AND "media_assets"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("media_assets"."status" IN ('quarantined', 'rejected') AND length(btrim("media_assets"."validation_reason")) > 0 AND "media_assets"."verified_at" IS NULL)

mission_slots_community_reach_ck.name: mission_slots_community_reach_ck

mission_slots_reach_bonus_ck.name: mission_slots_reach_bonus_ck
mission_slots_reach_bonus_ck.value:
"mission_slots"."type" = 'community' OR (
        ("mission_slots"."reach_level" = 'level_1' AND "mission_slots"."bonus_reward_minor" * 2 = "mission_slots"."base_reward_minor") OR
        ("mission_slots"."reach_level" = 'level_2' AND "mission_slots"."bonus_reward_minor" = "mission_slots"."base_reward_minor") OR
        ("mission_slots"."reach_level" = 'level_3' AND "mission_slots"."bonus_reward_minor" = "mission_slots"."base_reward_minor" * 2)
      )

slot_reservations_release_ck.name: slot_reservations_release_ck
slot_reservations_release_ck.value:
("slot_reservations"."status" IN ('active', 'converted') AND "slot_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("slot_reservations"."status" IN ('released', 'expired') AND "slot_reservations"."released_at" IS NOT NULL)

submission_disputes_resolution_time_ck.name: submission_disputes_resolution_time_ck
submission_disputes_resolution_time_ck.value:
("submission_disputes"."status" = 'open' AND "submission_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("submission_disputes"."status" <> 'open' AND "submission_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

submission_disputes_opener_shape_ck.name: submission_disputes_opener_shape_ck
submission_disputes_opener_shape_ck.value:
("submission_disputes"."opened_by" = 'creator' AND "submission_disputes"."correction_request_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("submission_disputes"."opened_by" = 'business' AND "submission_disputes"."correction_request_id" IS NULL)

submission_review_decisions_reason_ck.name: submission_review_decisions_reason_ck
submission_review_decisions_reason_ck.value:
("submission_review_decisions"."decision" = 'correction_requested' AND "submission_review_decisions"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("submission_review_decisions"."explanation")) > 0) OR
          ("submission_review_decisions"."decision" IN ('approved', 'auto_approved') AND "submission_review_decisions"."reason_code" IS NULL)

submission_review_decisions_actor_ck.name: submission_review_decisions_actor_ck
submission_review_decisions_actor_ck.value:
("submission_review_decisions"."actor_type" = 'user' AND "submission_review_decisions"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("submission_review_decisions"."actor_type" = 'service' AND "submission_review_decisions"."actor_id" IS NULL)
